The quest is finished. I killed the drowned sailor and the Drowned Captain on the Pale Harvest, took the key, and found a Kothringi Keystone in the strongbox instead of the Eye. I gave it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom, and she paid me 100 gold.

She didn't know the keystone, but she said it's Kothringi make. The next lead is the Chime-Keepers of Toklea in the Tulmek Washes, who keep what's left of Kothringi lore. She also said the Unbound haven't been to the wreck, and when I started to ask how she knew, she answered "we listen."

The game accepted my final notes and said it was over.
